title: HomeFlood Claims Service Standards and Time Limits
content:
Claims on **HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies** run on the following service standards and time limits, the same on every tier.

| Tier | Proof of loss due (days after the date of loss) | Payment after an agreed proof of loss (days) | Adjuster's first contact after the report (elapsed hours) | Suit limitation after a written denial (calendar months) | Appraisal available |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeFlood Renters | 60 | 30 | 24 | 24 | yes |
| HomeFlood Essential | 60 | 30 | 24 | 24 | yes |
| HomeFlood Standard | 60 | 30 | 24 | 24 | yes |
| HomeFlood Plus | 60 | 30 | 24 | 24 | yes |
| HomeFlood Premier | 60 | 30 | 24 | 24 | yes |
| HomeFlood Estate | 60 | 30 | 24 | 24 | yes |

- **Proof of loss**: the signed proof of loss must be received within 60 calendar days after the date of loss.
- **Payment**: Tidemark pays within 30 calendar days after the proof of loss is agreed.
- **Adjuster contact**: Tidemark's standard for the adjuster's first contact is 24 elapsed hours after the claim is reported.
- **Suit**: suit may be filed within 24 calendar months after the written denial.
- **Appraisal**: either party may demand appraisal of the amount of loss on every tier.
